source.author: verg
source.text: Atque illi Misenum in litore sicco, ut venere, vident indigna morte peremptum, Misenum Aeoliden, quo non praestantior alter aere ciere viros, Martemque accendere cantu.
source.text_original: Atque illi Misenum in litore sicco, / ut venere, vident indigna morte peremptum, / Misenum Aeoliden, quo non praestantior alter / aere ciere viros, Martemque accendere cantu.
source.text_english: And there on the dry shore they see Misenus, as they had come, slain by an unworthy death, Misenus the Aeolian, than whom no other was more outstanding at rousing men with bronze and kindling Mars with song.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: non illo certior alter pinguia letifera perfringere colla bipenni.
reuse.text_original: non illo certior alter / pinguia letifera perfringere colla bipenni.
reuse.text_english: no other was more certain than he to shatter the fat lethal necks with a two-edged axe.
